title: Top 5 Most EXTREME Places In The Solar System
hook: Number one rains molten glass sideways... but it's not even a planet.

items.name: Venus
items.stat: Surface heat hits 465°C, hot enough to melt lead, under crushing 90x Earth pressure.

items.name: Io
items.stat: Jupiter's moon has over 400 active volcanoes, the most volcanic world in the solar system.

items.name: Olympus Mons on Mars
items.stat: The tallest volcano known: 22 km high, nearly three times the height of Mount Everest.

items.name: Neptune
items.stat: The windiest planet, with supersonic storms screaming at up to 2,100 km/h.

items.name: The Sun's Corona
items.stat: The Sun's outer atmosphere blazes at over 1,000,000°C, hotter than its own surface.
